decisions.reason: Aligning Android language files does not change the independently defined iOS translation-system reconstruction requirement.
Language-file string alignment does not change the separate requirement for correct right-to-left layout behavior.
The Android language-file alignment decision does not alter iOS right-to-left layout support.
Android language-string alignment does not change app-bundle, code-shrinking, or image-removal size optimization rules.
Android language-file alignment does not change the iOS lightweight-app or duplicate-file-removal requirement.
The source change concerns Android localization files, not iOS version support or deprecated API replacement.
Android localization string alignment has no effect on the iOS Privacy Manifest requirement.
Language-file alignment does not change Android API-level, dependency-update, or deprecated-API requirements.
Aligning Android language files does not resolve whether the separate Chinese Youku video should remain or be removed.
Android language-file alignment does not change iOS certificate renewal or signing readiness.
Language-string alignment does not change the required Android release package format.
Android localization string alignment does not change the policy for removing unused sensitive permissions.
